The '''Fleet Command Academy''' was an establishment designed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to train personnel entering the [[Rebel Fleet Command/Legends|Fleet Command]] and [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|Starfighter Command]] of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]]. [[Elassar Targon]] attended the Fleet Command Academy before being assigned to [[Wraith Squadron]].
